She holds a clear transparent umbrella over her head with one hand, while her other hand holds a small white canvas tote bag. She wears a {argument name="clothing" default="dark teal oversized sweater, a long brown maxi skirt, and black chunky sneakers"}. The road is paved with concrete slabs featuring a unique pattern of deep circular indentations. The surface is wet and reflective, creating a beautiful, mirror-like glow. A thick white line runs straight down the left side of the street, leading the eye into the distance. The background consists of narrow two-story residential houses in muted beige and grey tones, a lush green tree canopy hanging over the right side of the street, wooden fences, a white garage door, and an intricate web of black power lines crisscrossing against the pale, overcast sky. The lighting is soft, diffused, and natural, typical of a rainy day, creating a dreamy, muted color palette of cool greys, faded greens, and earthy browns. Shallow depth of field, soft focus, cinematic composition. Realistic skin texture, visible pores, subtle moisture from the misty air, no beauty filter. Slight film grain, subtle chromatic aberration at the edges. A stray cat tail peeks from behind a wooden fence at the bottom left corner. Authentic Japanese street aesthetic.

Subject: 
A sunny afternoon

Main Subject: 
A vertical portrait centered on a woman in her 20s leaning against a long-pile beige sofa in an elegant interior with soft sunlight. She lightly holds a small red fruit in one hand, and a small plate with several red fruits is placed at her feet.

Character/Expression: 
The woman has a calm, mature impression. Dark brown shoulder-length {argument name="hairstyle" default="wavy hair"} with thin bangs covering the forehead. The face is turned slightly toward the camera, eyes looking straight into the lens. Eyebrows and eyes are soft, the mouth is slightly open, creating a quiet and intimate atmosphere. Skin is smooth but not overly polished, leaving natural color in the cheeks and lips.

Clothing/Pose: 
Wearing a pale champagne beige {argument name="outfit" default="satin slip dress"}. The chest is a shallow V-line with lace decoration, showing a delicate luster and the drape of the fabric. Paired with white lace-up over-the-knee socks. Leaning back on the sofa, supporting the upper body with the right hand on the seat behind, and picking a small {argument name="fruit" default="red fruit"} with the left hand near the face. Legs are extended forward, with one knee raised to create depth. Hair flows naturally over the shoulders and chest, and the hem of the clothing drapes softly over the thighs.

Background/Light: 
The interior has cream to ivory walls with elegant decorative moldings. Warm afternoon natural light shines diagonally from a window in the upper left, creating bright highlights on the top of the hair, forehead, cheeks, chest, thighs, and the texture of the sofa. The light is somewhat soft direct light, with shadows falling toward the lower right. The background is softly blurred into a melt-like state, and red fruits serve as small accents within the beige and ivory tones.

Composition/Camera: 
Vertical composition. A close-up portrait looking down slightly from above, with the subject positioned slightly to the right of the center. The face is in the upper middle, and the legs are prominently in the foreground, emphasizing perspective. Capturing from the upper body down to the feet, showing the enveloping texture of the sofa. A small plate is placed at the bottom. Focus on the face and hands, with a shallow depth of field to blur the background and periphery.

Texture/Style: 
Realistic photographic expression. Warm natural light, low contrast, soft backlighting, and delicate film grain. Meticulous depiction of the smooth reflection of satin, the fine weave of lace, the fluffy texture of the sofa, and the natural texture of the skin. The overall color scheme is based on beige, cream, and honey tones, resulting in a calm and elegant design. Finished as an indoor portrait that conveys silence and warmth.

Negative: 
Unnatural faces, unnatural gaze, extra fingers, missing fingers, fused limbs, broken joints, distorted clothing, poor contact with props, floating, unnatural gravity, shadows inconsistent with light source, excessive skin correction, overly young face, information overload in background, garbled text, logos, watermarks.
